subject.text: My monitor is dead, please replace it

description.text: The monitor screen has been black since I came back from lunch.
The monitor's power light is blue.
In the middle of the screen there is small text: "No signal – HDMI 2".
The cable from the computer is plugged into port HDMI 1 and is not loose.
Earlier my bag bumped the buttons under the monitor.

explanation: The monitor is on and the cable is in HDMI 1, but the monitor is reading HDMI 2 because its buttons were bumped. The monitor is healthy, so guide Ratna to choose input source HDMI 1 with the monitor buttons.
hints: The power light is on and the cable is plugged in. What is the monitor reading right now?
Compare the port written on the screen with the port the cable is plugged into.
